summary: Your thirteenth teach-back. You answer a colleague who wants agents everywhere, explain agent versus workflow in 5 sentences with a fair case for each, check six key points, and test your explanation against the evidence of your own runs.

items.text: Write what you would answer the colleague, one workflow task and one agent task from your project
Explain agent versus workflow in 5 sentences or a 60-second voice note
Tick the six key points your explanation said clearly and count them
Check your explanation against the evidence and the comparison table
Write a better sentence for the biggest gap
Play the Agent or Workflow game to the end and see your score
